name: nyxkin
description: a Nyxkin, a pale dark-elf woman with long black hair, pointed ears and violet eyes, in black leather armour with silver trim and a purple cloak and skirt, a silver-white recurve bow in her LEFT hand on the screen-right side drawn with an arrow by her RIGHT hand, riding a shaggy black stag with large pale branching antlers, a brown leather harness set with a purple gem and dark hooves
hands: the bow stays in her left hand on the screen-right side and her right hand draws the string and the arrow on the screen-left side
